title: Adacta's own AdInsure platform makes it a competitor rather than a complement
content:
Adacta runs AdInsure, its own proprietary insurance platform. The research marks the lead explicitly as not a complement: the firm occupies the layer a Powerhouse-based solution would occupy in an insurance engagement, so a joint demo would compete with the product Adacta sells.

The screen is worth recording rather than discarding, because on surface characteristics Adacta looks like a good lead — a specialist insurance implementer in the region. What disqualifies it is the ownership of a platform, not a lack of capability or interest, and that is only visible if the tool column is read as a competitive position rather than as a list of skills.

The practical consequence is that Adacta is channel and competitor at the same time. Any approach has to assume the platform will be defended, which puts the lead behind those whose tooling moves work around but records nothing about what was decided.
